osquery.name: t1562_003_processes
osquery.query_text: SELECT pid, parent, name, path, cmdline, cwd, on_disk FROM processes LIMIT 200;

osquery.name: t1562_003_filesystem
osquery.query_text: SELECT path, filename, directory, size, uid, gid, mode, mtime FROM file WHERE path LIKE '/tmp/%' OR path LIKE '/var/tmp/%' OR path LIKE '/dev/shm/%' LIMIT 200;

osquery.name: t1562_003_network
osquery.query_text: SELECT pid, fd, socket, family, protocol, local_address, remote_address, local_port, remote_port, state FROM process_open_sockets LIMIT 200;
